name: Know Your Ship
description: ARIA shows you round the Aqua Nova.

objectives.description: Open the logbook on your desk (your quarters)
Open your PED (top-right corner) and read your tasks
Leave your quarters for the walkway
Walk to the bridge, the door at the end of the walkway

onStart.text: {captain}, before we take her out, a short tour of the ship. Anything you have already done, I have already noted. The walkway and the bridge are the rest.

onComplete.text: That is the ship, Captain. The helm and systems are signed off. You can also ask Commander Chen to move the ship on the communicator. OERA will send your orders soon.

message.subject: Sea trials orders
message.text:
{captain},

Welcome aboard the Aqua Nova, and thank you for answering the call at such short notice. The Alliance is aware of the circumstances of Captain Voss's departure, and we are grateful for your steadiness.

Before the ship takes on survey work, OERA requires a full set of sea trials. Get the Aqua Nova out of dry dock at Woods Hole and underway. Take her below 30 meters, run her up to speed, then bring her back to the surface and send us a report from the Comms station. The antenna must be at 15 meters or shallower to reach us.

Take your time and trust your crew. ARIA has the full trials checklist and Commander Chen knows these waters.

Accept the mission when you are ready.

O.E.R.A. Operations Directorate

hints.message: Your logbook is the laptop on the desk, {captain}. It holds your orders.
Your PED was on the bed. Once you have it, its button is at the top of the screen.
The bridge is the door at the end of the main walkway, {captain}.
